verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer docs explicitly describe creating Bearer API tokens whose effective access is the intersection of the token owner's permission profile and the token's assigned scopes, enabling least-privilege API credentials, and marketing copy indicates agent identities are managed alongside human identities in the same access system. Missing for 10: explicit end-to-end documentation of issuing/scoping a token specifically for an AI agent identity, and independent/hands-on verification that scope enforcement works as described.
